fixes: Fixed the episode list showing only skeletons — dev1.9's restructure split the episode list into a state holder and a plain emitter, and the derived episode rows were plain variables that nothing subscribed to, so the detail page never re-rendered when a list landed; rows are snapshot state now and the detail page and download sheet read them in their own scope, so episode rows appear as soon as a source lands (list and grid, detail and sheet)
